purpose: Original four Art lifetime questions retained, plus additive native-history durability checks; separate from the frozen historical development set.

questions.query: Does opening Workbench copy previous Art conversation logs when the Art panel is hidden?
facts: Hidden startup reads only the small profile and performs no conversation archive reads or writes.
Explicit Art opening restores incrementally; the first new event creates an immutable-parent linked segment.

questions.query: What happens if a saved Art conversation parent segment is missing or a process crashes while appending?
facts: Missing or inconsistent chains refuse continuation and preserve the saved pointer; restoring a missing file permits retry.
Only the newest modern unterminated tail can recover its complete committed prefix; original bytes remain unchanged.

questions.query: Can I cancel full Art JSONL export, and will it preserve an existing destination on Windows?
facts: Stop or Cancel export interrupts bounded work; output is staged privately until native atomic replacement succeeds.
The byte-exact audit includes all segments and original image offsets; it is not a single-file conversation import format.

questions.query: What bounds memory when restoring and exporting large Art conversation archives?
facts: The reader limits records to 32 MiB, chains to 4096 segments and individual interactive polling input to 1 MiB.
The editable transcript has matching read/write limits of 16384 turns and 16 MiB of UTF-8 text; full audit export streams without collecting that transcript.

questions.query: Can confirmed native Undo or Redo results survive an unreadable Art profile or a failed conversation append without duplicate model context?
facts: The Workbench captures the small saved-session association without constructing Art or scanning transcript; a later profile outage retains that association, while an unknown source fails explicitly instead of attaching to another session.

Every associated native completion is atomically journalled before archive append with stable identity and epoch. Raw history and visible conversation commits are tracked separately; the journal is removed only after the visible turn and profile checkpoint commit.

Validated incremental replay deduplicates exact pending results, including interrupted cleanup, and cleanup does not rewind the latest compacted-context result. Resource refusal is explicit; no unbounded volatile fallback is used.
